authorization: 2026-11-01 user request for deeper research and improved controlled local experiments
purpose: Paired finite backbone screen: can longer vector returns improve task expression before allocation research?
allocation: uniform shared protocol-seeded 32-preference pool; episode-fixed behavior preference and head

screen_gate.checkpoint: final only; intermediate checkpoints describe trajectories, never select a best model
screen_gate.lunar: each training seed: at least 8/10 native +100 AND pad-x outcomes at landing-heavy preference
screen_gate.minecart: each training seed: at least 5/10 positive ore deliveries at [0.45,0.45,0.1]
screen_gate.effect: Report paired seed-level utility differences and all individual seed outcomes; 3 pairs are a feasibility screen, not a significance claim

limitations: n=20 is an explicit unvalidated hypothesis, not a Minecart paper default
Uncorrected off-policy multi-step targets may introduce bias
Both arms receive the same longer budget; historical cohorts are not matched controls
No change to frozen gamma, scale, reference point, final-test split or historical unlock gates
stop_rule: Exactly 12 jobs. No seed replacement, outcome-based extension, checkpoint cherry-picking, or automatic final-test unlock. Technical failures remain recorded.
